title: Hannibal: invasion and return
hook: Did crossing the Alps settle the war?

predict.question: Where was the war’s decisive final battle?

frames.heading: From Iberia
frames.text: Hannibal’s army leaves Iberia for Italy.

frames.heading: Italian campaign
frames.text: Many Roman allies remain with Rome.

frames.heading: Return to Africa
frames.text: Rome wins at Zama in North Africa.

reveal: An invasion route is not the whole war. Crossing the Alps brought Hannibal’s army into Italy, but many Roman allies stayed with Rome. A Roman campaign in Africa drew Hannibal back; Rome’s victory at Zama ended the contest on another shore.
limit: The Alpine pass and exact march are uncertain; this line does not choose a pass.

sources.section: Second Punic War paragraphs and Zama (202 BCE)
